title: Managing multiple social media accounts?
description:
These AI and creator tools can make your workflow faster and more organized.
ChatGPT — brainstorm content ideas, hooks, captions, and content plans.
Canva — create social posts, stories, thumbnails, and branded visuals.
Metricool — schedule content and track social media performance.
Use AI to simplify repetitive tasks, but always review your content before publishing.
